description: Unit naming pattern rules for BLUE and RED coalition forces

categories.name: Naming Conventions
categories.description: Rules about unit names and patterns across all coalitions

rules.name: BLUE Force Naming Standard (AI Units)
rules.description: All BLUE AI-controlled units must use Blue-X or named convention pattern for identification
exceptions: Client-controlled aircraft use their own callsigns (naming not enforced)
Ground units may have different naming conventions

rules.name: RED Force Naming Standard
rules.description: All RED units must use RED-X or BOMBER suffix pattern for identification

rules.name: No Test Aircraft Pattern
rules.description: Units with TEST patterns should not appear in production missions
